physicalLaw: Hold is C-1. Linear is C0. Named power eases are C0. Cubic Hermite is C1 iff m_in=m_out. Independent in/out Hermite is C0 with a legal artistic corner. Periodic C2 spline is not live and is illegal on the W.
CSS cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) is a timing function on the unit square, P0=(0,0), P3=(1,1), x in [0,1]. It is a preset compiler into Hermite, not the store.
AE value graph stores independent in/out (influence, speed). Speed graph is the same handles viewed as |vdot|. Spatial Bezier is a different object.
Rive Cubic = CSS-like. Rive Cubic Value = AE-grade handles with legal overshoot. That is the named grade.
m is velocity in channel-units/second. CurveTrack already exposes evaluateCurveTrackDerivative.
A take beat is a Heaviside step on an action set. Physics state is not a function of t. Easing a fire is a category error.
